shortDescription: Published (Workshop 3786107692). Shared foundation for the Radius UI suite: one colour set, one card/hover treatment, a shape module, a text field, a scroll widget, a font resolver, a world-map bake, a Perf module, and a 272-icon shared art library. Generation 8 staged for publish.
body:
## What this mod is

A **library mod**. It adds no defs, no world state, and no Harmony patches. It exists so the
Radius UI suite draws with one design language instead of many forked copies of one.

Design language: flat 2.0, rounded, iOS-like, colour-forward.

Architecture of record: `_dev/RadiusUIFramework/ARCHITECTURE.md` (human-owned). Nothing in
`_dev/` ships.

## Status: generation 8 STAGED FOR PUBLISH (Workshop 3786107692)

Last shipped generation was 5 (2026-08-20). Generations 6, 7 and 8 are built and green but
**not yet on the Workshop**.

- **Gen 6** - radial vocabulary (`Spatial.Arc`, `Palette.Commands`, `SizeAnim`).
- **Gen 7** - the World layer becomes assertable (additive, no code moved).
- **Gen 8** - `WorldSnapshot.Get` seed/window fix. **Breaking signature change.**
- Also unshipped: the overview-tab standard (`Metrics.Tabs` + `Panes/OverviewTab`).

Build green, Release, 0 warnings. Git: `Astryls/Radius-UI-Framework` (private), `main`.
Autosave commits every 15 min. Licence MIT. Author `astryl` by authorship, not by restamp.

### Publish-prep pass done 2026-08-21 (this session)

Verified green: Release build 0 warnings; `Assemblies/` holds the DLL **alone**; 272 PNGs with
no stray `.svg`/`.psd`; zero em/en dashes in About.xml or Keyed; zero missing keyed strings;
`Preview.png` 1280x720; `ModIcon.png` 256x256; `PublishedFileId.txt` present (required - its
absence would create a duplicate Workshop item instead of updating).

Fixed: **`DebugType=none` + `DebugSymbols=false` under a Release condition in the csproj.**
`OutputPath` is `..\Assemblies\` for every configuration, so a Release build dropped
`RadiusUI.Framework.pdb` straight into the upload folder - and `.gitignore` carries `*.pdb`, so
it never showed in `git status`. Now structural rather than a manual delete each publish.

**Do not trust a literal-only grep to condemn a keyed string.** The 11 apparent orphans are all
live: 8 accent names resolve through `("RadiusUI.Accent." + name).Translate()` and 3 more take
`.Translate(arg)`, which a `"key".Translate()` pattern misses. Deleting them would have broken
the settings UI.

**Build Release explicitly.** `dotnet build` defaults to Debug and, because OutputPath ignores
configuration, silently replaces the shipping DLL with the Debug artifact.

### Publish protocol

`_dev/publish-prep.ps1 -ModId RadiusUIFramework` then `_dev/publish-restore.ps1` (script not
currently on disk under `_dev/` - locate or re-create before relying on it). It takes its own
D: backup, disables `ModmixerGitAutosave`, and holds everything off the runtime allowlist.

- **Delete genuine garbage BEFORE prep.** It works off an allowlist, so anything unrecognised is
  *held* and faithfully *restored*. A stray nested copy of the mod (gitlink 4f5fe71, carrying
  its own `.git`) had to be deleted first (f3540d1) or it would have come straight back.
- **`.modmixer/` must stay in place**, or Modmixer restamps About.xml's author and re-serializes
  the description.
- **Restore in the same session** - autosave is disabled during the window; if it fired it would
  commit the stripped tree and delete all source from HEAD.
- `.git` is left in place by the tool, conflicting with PUBLISH_CHECKLIST section 6. Unresolved.

## Texture library (272 icons, 19 categories)

Imported from five source mods, byte-for-byte: no resampling, no recolouring.

Namespaced under `Textures/RadiusUI/` because `ContentFinder` returns the *last-loaded* match,
so an un-namespaced sibling in a consumer would silently shadow it. Consumers must delete their
local copies, not merely stop referencing them.

### The art is three tiers, not one family

Only tier 1 can be re-themed:

- **Glyphs** - flat white RGB, all information in alpha. Tinted via `Palette`/accent.
- **Illustrations (`Anatomy/`)** - shaded beige art. Never tinted.
- **Semantic markers (`Marker/`)** - colour *is* the meaning. Hand synced to the palette: if the
  ramp changes, those 8 PNGs must be re-authored.

### Aliases are a hard requirement

12 retired names must stay exposed or consumer call sites break. `Squad/` ships 5 files but
offers 8 emblem slots; `Reminder/` ships 7 but offers 8 picker slots. `Action/LockOpen` and
`Action/LockClosed` scored 0.927 similarity and were deliberately kept apart - a **state pair**.

**No magnifier/search glyph exists**, deliberately: `FlatField` ships with no leading icon
rather than misusing `Action/EyeOpen`.

## Components

- `Tokens/` - `Palette` (+ Health, Ideology, Needs, Social, Bands, Commands partials), `Metrics`
  (+ Rows, Tabs partials). Pure values, no game state.
- `Chrome/` - `CardChrome`, `FlatField`, `Spatial` (+ Bands, Arc partials), `SizeAnim`.
- `Widgets/` - `FlatScroll`, `UIKit` (+ Bars partial).
- `Panes/OverviewTab` - standard tab footprint + live pane clamp.
- `Icons/` - `RadiusIcon` (art tier lives here), `IconSet` + generated per-tier partials.
- `Text/RadiusFont` - framework-owned font resolution and measurement.
- `World/WorldSnapshot` - real-terrain minimap bake + `TerritoryPaint`.
- `Settings/`, `Compat/ModCompat`, `Perf/`.

Several classes are `partial` (`Spatial`, `UIKit`, `Metrics`, `Palette`, `IconSet`) so
concurrent sessions add a **file** instead of editing a shared one. That is the section 13
recommendation and it is what let two sessions work this tree simultaneously.

### `World/WorldSnapshot` - real-terrain minimap bake (section 16)

Bounded BFS from a centre tile, rasterising each tile's actual polygon onto the tangent plane.
768squared `Color32`, ~2.3 MB reused, ~5 ms upload, cached on centre/range/orientation/window/paint.

`TerritoryPaint` is **immutable** to the bake: a changed claim map must arrive as a new `Key` or
the cache returns a stale texture. Use `Transport` across a re-centre; deriving the basis from a
fixed world axis makes north swing and reads as the map rotating. Terrain colours are map
**content**, so this file does not route through `Palette`.

**Gen 8 fix (the blank-map bug).** `Get` separates the projection origin from the baked
`window`, so a caller can pan without re-projecting (moving the origin warps the picture; moving
the window just slides which part of the same projection is baked). `seed` moved from
`PlanetTile = default` to `PlanetTile? = null`: `PlanetTile.Valid` is `tileId >= 0` and Invalid
is -1, so `default(PlanetTile)` - tileId **0** - tested as VALID. Every caller omitting the seed
flood-filled from tile 0, failed the window cull on its first iteration, enqueued nothing and
got back the `WaterColor` pre-fill. It presented as "the world map is blank" when it was really
the untouched buffer.

### `Panes/OverviewTab` - the standard tab footprint (section 17)

**Every module replacing a vanilla overview tab renders at the same size.** Standard is
`Metrics.OverviewTabW` x `OverviewTabH` = **890 x 790** at scale 1, user scale clamped
**0.70-1.10** defaulting to **1.00**, height clamped against the live inspect pane.

These tabs share one inspect pane and players flip between them constantly, so a size difference
makes the pane appear to jump on every switch. The footprint is a property of the *pane*.

Audit (2026-08-20): Health and Needs matched at 890x790 @1.00, but **Social Tab had its axes
transposed** (790x890 @0.85, rendering 672x756) - right numbers, swapped axes, in both the
constants and the comment describing them. Invisible in isolation, obvious side by side.

The helper also owns the **clamp** (a bare 790 overflows at low resolution or high UI scale; the
limit must come from live `PaneTopY` because RimHUD and other pane mods raise it, and
`UI.screenHeight` is already divided by `Prefs.UIScale`) and the **default scale**.

**Hosted-tab trap:** a tab whose rect is owned by a host (Radius UI - Inspector) must use
`MaxHeightHosted(chromeH)`, never `MaxHeight`. The host sizes its panel from the declared tab
size then patches `PaneTopY` to report that panel's top, so clamping against `PaneTopY` clamps
against your own output - the two chase each other and the value changes on the frame hosting
begins, which is the flicker.

### `Chrome/FlatField` - the flat text field

Framework-owned because it is **shared-GUIStyle surgery**. `Widgets.TextField` draws with
`Text.CurTextFieldStyle`, whose eight state backgrounds are vanilla's tan bevel, so a consumer's
own plate goes *under* vanilla chrome. The fix is a copy of that style with all eight nulled.

Four encoded rules: never mutate the shared style (`GUI.skin.textField` is a pure no-op -
`Widgets.TextField` never reads it); copy from `Text.textFieldStyles[Small]`, not
`CurTextFieldStyle`, which resolves against ambient `Text.Font`; cache behind an epoch guard on
both the source style object and its font; `GUI.SetNextControlName` immediately before
`GUI.TextField` or focus detection silently never matches.

The clear button's `ButtonInvisible` and 24px reserve are emitted whenever `clearButton` is
true, not only when non-empty: an empty field can become non-empty between the input pass and
the Repaint pass of one frame, and a control appearing mid-frame renumbers every later control.

### `Chrome/Spatial` - the shape module (section 15)

What `CardChrome` structurally cannot draw. Ends a four-way fork; `BottomBand` alone had three.
Generated textures only, no shipped art.

Cost discipline: a 9-slice is nine draw calls - surfaces and row cards only; `Pill` is three;
faint row stripes stay square. `Pill` samples **half** discs by texcoord because whole discs
under a rect double-draw the caps. `BottomBand` clips rather than shrinks. All textures are
`HideAndDontSave` or `UnloadUnusedAssets` destroys them mid-session.

`Spatial.Arc` (gen 6): one cached texture per **shape** (inner ratio + sweep), rotated to
bearing. Angle convention **0 = up, clockwise**, and `AngleFromUp`/`InSector` ship WITH the
drawing so a consumer's hit shape cannot drift from the drawn shape. Rotation must use
`Verse.UI.RotateAroundPivot`, never `GUIUtility.RotateAroundPivot` - the latter reads its pivot
in SCREEN space, which is invisible at UI scale 1.0 and scatters wedges at any other scale.

### `Perf/` - hot-path utilities

`FrameGate`, `Throttle`, `TextMemo`, `ScratchText`, `SnapshotTable`, `IdMap`,
`PooledWindowState`, `ViewCull`, `PatchGuard`, `DefTable`, `FrameProbe`. Main-thread only.
`RadiusFont.Size/Height/Width` route through `TextMemo` behind unchanged signatures.

## Binding rules for framework edits (section 13)

Additive only; never change the value behind an existing name; missing token means add a new
one; **rebuild every consumer after any framework rebuild** and hash-verify their game-side
copies; the 12 icon aliases are permanent; rule 6 - any vanilla-overview-tab replacement uses
`Panes/OverviewTab`. Prefer a new `partial` file over editing a shared one. Always re-read a
file from disk immediately before editing it, **including ARCHITECTURE.md**.

**Generation rule (has now cost user-facing crashes twice):** a consumer must require the first
generation **that cannot predate the members it uses** - not the generation current when it was
written. `RadiusFont.Epoch` landed additively inside gen 3; Quest Menu asserted 3; an early
gen-3 framework passed the guard and threw `MissingMethodException: Method not found: int
RadiusFont.get_Epoch()` ~100x/frame. Anything under `World/` therefore requires **7**, not 6.

## Outstanding work (next session starts here)

1. **Consumer sweep for gen 8 is owed and is a publish blocker.** The `Get` signature moved, so
   a stale consumer DLL throws `MissingMethodException` at *draw* time, not load time. Ideology,
   Quest Menu and Faction Menu assert 8 and appear rebuilt; verify, do not assume.
2. **Radius UI - World Map under-asserts.** It requires generation **6** while using
   `WorldSnapshot.BiomeColor`, and its DLL predates the gen-8 build. `BiomeColor`'s signature did
   not move, so this is not a live crash - but it is exactly the gen-3 hole. Move it to 7 and
   rebuild.
3. About.xml `<description>` still describes the pre-generation-4 framework (no shape module,
   no world bake, no Perf, no tab standard). Needs a rewrite before upload; user owns this copy.
4. Generations 6-8 have had **no clean-load test and no Dubs performance sign-off**
   (PUBLISH_CHECKLIST sections 5 and 7).
5. `_dev/RadiusUIFramework/` has no `STEAM_DESCRIPTION.txt`, `UPDATE_NOTES.txt` or
   `HELICOPTER_VIEW.md` (checklist section 2).
6. **Social Tab must be re-pointed at the standard footprint.** It renders 672x756 against the
   standard 890x790 - a visible change for existing users, so it needs sign-off, not a silent fix.
7. **Health and Needs should migrate to `Panes/OverviewTab`** to retire their private
   `MaxWindowH` copies. They already agree numerically, so no visible change.
8. **Faction Menu still carries two forks** the framework now owns: `Chrome/FlatField.cs`
   (redundant) and `Source/Core/WorldSnapshot.cs` (re-point at the framework copy).

Game-side `Mods/RadiusUIFramework` is confirmed a **junction/symlink** to the workspace, so a
build lands in the game in place and no copy step is owed. RimWorld must be closed before
building or the loaded DLL is write-locked through the junction.
